notes: FIXTURE catalog for LEAF Phase 2 (leaf.disturbance law mechanical_response_v1, leaf.demography law age_background_stress_v1) on top of the Phase 1 growth / water-use laws. EVERY number below is an UNCALIBRATED fixture chosen for readable contrasts and for tests; none is a literature fit, a field value or a study calibration. Copy and edit; do not cite these numbers as species parameters. Each species carries its complete record: allometry, roots, growth, water_use, mortality and disturbance live side by side. life_expectancy is metadata only (a mean, not a maximum): nothing in LEAF kills a plant at that age.

grass.name: fixture shallow-rooted bunchgrass (burial sensitive, shallow anchorage)

allometry.notes: diameter_m = a_d * B^b_d ; height_m = a_h * B^b_h. Fixture coefficients.

porosity.status: uncalibrated constant matching the current MAPLE default; used by native MAPLE wind, unused by LEAF ecology

growth.status: FIXTURE coefficients, not literature fits. intrinsic_rate_per_year must stay within the qualified [0, 1] weekly-Euler range.

water_use.status: FIXTURE. Documented LEAF demand adaptation, not a STEPWAT daily-physiology claim.

life_expectancy.notes: metadata only; mean life expectancy, NOT a hard maximum age; no automatic death

mortality.status: UNCALIBRATED FIXTURE. Explicit opt-in laws; every coefficient is a catalog value, none is a literature constant.

units.low_threshold: ratio of actual support to required support (kg*year / kg*year), a support diagnostic, not a production yield
units.exempt_until_age_days: days: plants with age <= this are never evaluated for stress (first-year rule)
units.limit_years / counter_cap_years: years with a LOW ratio; a healthy year decrements the counter
units.biomass_loss_fraction: fraction of dry AGB lost per stressed year when the plant survives

mortality.notes: dormant (zero required support) or exempt years are never counted as stress

disturbance.status: UNCALIBRATED FIXTURE threshold / response curves; no wind or water physics.

units.burial: increment in fraction of the intact allometric height (scale=height_fraction) or m; lethal_height_fraction = post-event burial / intact height
units.exposure: m of root exposure (establishment ground minus current ground)
units.abrasion: dose in the declared dose_unit (NOT a transport flux)

disturbance.notes: burial / exposure injuries respond to this event's increment; absolute post-event depths cross the lethal / dislodgement thresholds

shrub.name: fixture deep-rooted shrub (burial tolerant, firm anchorage)

porosity.status: uncalibrated constant matching the current MAPLE default; used by native MAPLE wind, unused by LEAF ecology

water_use.status: FIXTURE. Per TOTAL dry AGB (live_fraction is not applied again). Documented LEAF demand adaptation.

life_expectancy.notes: metadata only; mean, not a maximum

units.growth_ratio: actual growth / planned growth over the year (kg / kg); not evaluated when the plan is zero (mature size cap, dormancy)

units.exposure: m (gross erosion depth of the event)
